2608.25080.title: NVExplain: Explaining Time Series Forecasting with Latent Trajectory Analysis and Structure-Preserving Surrogates
2608.25080.paper_summary: Time series forecasting models are widely used in high-stakes settings, yet their predictions remain difficult to interpret because existing post-hoc methods often ignore temporal dependence and fail to provide horizon-specific explanations. We propose a model-agnostic explainability framework that explains forecasting predictions by attributing each forecast horizon to temporally relevant historical lags. The framework models forecasting as a latent trajectory and introduces semantic flow to quantify how information evolves across time in the model's internal representations. By aggregating semantic flow, it constructs a lag-horizon attribution matrix that captures horizon-resolved temporal influence. To improve explainability, we further generate structure-preserving perturbations and fit sparse local surrogate models, producing human-readable and temporally coherent explanations. We evaluate the method using faithfulness and stability diagnostics across multiple benchmark datasets. Results show that the semantic-flow variant achieves competitive or superior faithfulness compared to standard post-hoc baselines, while being substantially more computationally efficient. Stability analysis further demonstrates that the explanations are robust and identifies regimes where interpretation should be applied with caution.
2608.25080.paper_summary_zh: 時間序列預測模型在高風險環境中被廣泛使用，然而它們的預測結果仍然難以解釋，因為現有的事後方法往往忽略了時間依賴性，並且未能提供特定於預測時間範圍的解釋。我們提出了一種與模型無關的可解釋性框架，通過將每個預測時間範圍歸因於與時間相關的歷史滯後來解釋預測結果。該框架將預測建模為潛在的軌跡，並引入語義流來量化信息在模型內部表示中的演變過程。通過聚合語義流，它構建了一個滯後-時間範圍歸因矩陣，以捕捉時間範圍解決的時間影響。為了提高可解釋性，我們進一步生成保持結構的擾動並擬合稀疏的局部替代模型，產生可讀且時間上連貫的解釋。我們使用忠實性和穩定性診斷在多個基準數據集上評估該方法。結果顯示，語義流變體在忠實性方面達到了與標準事後基準相當或更優的表現，同時在計算效率上顯著更高。穩定性分析進一步證明了解釋的穩健性，並識別出應謹慎應用解釋的範疇。
